title: Void Starflow
text: Immersion deals 1 true damage each second. Only creatures and players can be teleported to a nearby safe spot. A Spacetime Anchoring Sigil or riding a tamed Void Manta protects you from both fluid effects.
Carry starflow in a bucket. Liquid Crystal Balls supply unlimited external extraction, while manual container transfers still use the actual stored amount. You can fish in Void Starflow.
